# @surfaces-ui/agent

AgentBackend interface, event helpers and stream adapters for Surfaces UI chat.

The `AgentBackend` interface (one `send` is one turn), event helpers, a scripted agent for tests, `toolCallingAgent` for any model with tool calls, and `dataTools`, which lets a model list and describe tables (never their values).

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/agent
```

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.
